Turn customer feedback into revenue — automatically
Auto-send surveys the moment a deal moves, capture every response right on the record, and act before customers churn. No exports. No manual matching.

WHY TEAMS ENABLE IT
Everything happens where you already work
Zero manual work
Surveys fire on CRM events and responses auto-link back to the exact record. No CSV exports, no matching.
Feedback on the record
NPS, CSAT, ratings & scores show right on the Lead, Contact or Deal — never leave your CRM.
Act in the moment
A low score can trigger a task, alert or workflow instantly — catch unhappy customers before they churn.
Measure the impact
Dashboards tie sentiment to pipeline & revenue, so you see exactly what feedback is worth.
When you enable, this integration will
Full transparency — you stay in control and can disable anytime.
